allowedSourceMaterial.overview: In 1880s Australia, a lawman offers renegade Charlie Burns a difficult choice. In order to save his younger brother from the gallows, Charlie must hunt down and kill his older brother, who is wanted for rape and murder. Venturing into one of the Outback's most inhospitable regions, Charlie faces a terrible moral dilemma that can end only in violence.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Tasked with fratricide to save his youngest kin, Charlie enters the brutal Outback knowing any resolution demands blood.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: In 1880s Australia, a lawman gives renegade Charlie Burns a brutal ultimatum: track down and execute his fugitive older brother, or his captured younger brother will hang.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, deliberate, and fiercely suspenseful. A demanding frontier drama best taken in with full focus.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director John Hillcoat delivers a severe Australian Western where family loyalty and frontier justice collide in a sun-scorched moral crucible.
